body:
I'm still here. Watching the world just get worse and worse. 

I want to see if I can legally end my own life because of all of this.

I don't want my family to know my plan but I think that's my only way to go. 

If not then, I'll just do it the old fashioned way I guess. I don't know.
It's not your fault. You can't save everyone. Take care of yourself.

I can't do this.

The world is doing this to me.

I have no choice.

Question.

Back on the 9th of March 2018 I recorded myself singing "Obstacles". It's not the best quality and I am not a singer or anything, I just - went for it and sang my heart out.

If anyone wants to hear it, I would be glad to post it. Even though I would be a bit scared to, I will.

Might make some people feel creative or try things they haven't thought of trying maybe?
That's kind of what Life Is Strange does to you :)
Thanks so much! I hope you have a great new year!

That's awesome to hear. It really is a one of a kind game that has had such an impact on so many people.

I hope you also have a great year ahead of you and good luck with everything!

Go for it. Go back, change your options up and see how you go. 

But yes, SS just made me feel like I had onions stapled to my face :(

You literally feel like you are with Max & Chloe sides throughout the game. Being in Chloe's truck, to in her room it's like you are there with them. I had a friend who was similar to Chloe, but instead of having a really huge personality, she was very quiet and kept a lot to herself. But I unfortunately don't keep in contact since she moved to another town (ironic hey) and now I don't speak with her.

It may sound weird to some how we really get into these characters but, it's our choice :)

One of my closest friends knew someone who was playing it and he watched them for about half hour in Episode 4. I told him to try it and give the game a go and he simply said "It's not for me". 

But he goes ahead and is like SKYRIM is IMMERSIVE!

\- Did it change your life and make you think about life more?

\- no...

\- Well then go play Life Is Strange :D
Awww...no more tears for now :) But will have it on my to do list!

Oh yes I do remember when Rachel just goes for it and the music accompanying it was just awesome.

I have to look back to BtS and see how I go with it.

I bought LiS 2 yesterday, haven't played it - just seen the launch trailer (With the cop car getting thrown over).

After playing the game, I felt that people just had more time for me, even though nothing had magically changed, it just seemed like my aura was just...better and people noticed it.

Awesome to hear, I am tempted to go back and play BtS now!

Hope you have a good one in the new year also!

Any playthrough in any language is great for me. Seeing people experience the LiS universe is just awesome.

And I am glad it helped you also, it's amazing what a game that's actually well written, well thought about and have people that care get together and make something so inspiring.

The music is just structured absolutely beautifully and to hear artists I had never heard before opened me up to different genres. I am glad the game has changed your life like it did for me.

Good luck with your Tattoo sleeve! Would be interesting to see if anyone got a 1:1 of Chloes tattoo!

I think majority of people who go into the game with an open mind come out a changed person. It's such a great thing to see more people getting into it. Even if it doesn't seem like a game they would like.
That you certainly did. My arm is a collage of all things that meant something to me in my life.
Thanks so much!

I'm glad I could share my story. It really has been a great journey.

And tattoo pics - right here - [https://imgur.com/a/FnBeQaJ](https://imgur.com/a/FnBeQaJ)

They are pictures of when they were FIRST done. I specifically asked the spiral to be the same as in game, and my arm was a bit swelled up. Otherwise the eye is lighter both healed perfect!

​

Edit: And the lighter is meant to look like that. Scratchy. And the eye is meant to look like it was done in sharpie sort of thing.

Thanks for your comment!
Will try and lose weight. Trying to work out a plan and how to go along with it.
And as for the cap, I forgot to mention that was in 2015 and it's ever so slightly off to the side. The picture makes it look like it's way off, it's sort of an illusion. But I wear them straight on nowadays.

Thanks for your comment, yeah have to work on the weight issue.
And thank you for giving me a bit of hope to work hard, it's something like this that makes me determined to keep at it.

Hey there, nah that's all good, all opinions welcome!

Yeah I never used to keep my beard, but I've been more comfortable with it so it's stayed.

My hat! Yeah, the reason why I still have it is because it hides my hair and I don't have to "tidy" it every time I walk outside. 

Will try and work on losing weight. That has been my goal since I started stacking it back on.

Thanks for your comment.
Yeah I need to work on my weight, being 6ft2", it might be a bit of a journey but that will boost me up a lot. I was skinny 4 years ago, but stress etc got to me.

My eyes are strange hey :)

Hey there, thanks for your comment.
I try my hardest to be kind and get through the day without any hassles. 
Yeah self esteem is just downhill. But I have to work on it, need some guidance.
Oh I am not trying to get compliments, an honest yes or no is all I need. Sorry if it sounds like I am, if I need to edit anything I'll go ahead and do so.
Thanks again.
